grammar.summary: 本课学习见面问候语 How are you? 及其回答，辨析 fine/good/well 的回应方式。

points.title: How are you? 问候及回答
points.explanation: How are you? 是熟人间的问候，回答用 I'm fine / OK / very well, thank you. And you?（你呢？）形成对话闭环。

examples.en: How are you today? I'm very well, thank you.
examples.cn: 你今天好吗？我很好，谢谢。

points.title: Nice to see you 与 Nice to meet you
points.explanation: 初次见面用 meet；已认识的人再见用 see you。

exercises.q: Look at that fat man. ___ very lazy.
